text:
NOTE
**Still not ready — merge commit is still in the history**

New: The author pushed twice and asked for a review, but the commit messages are unchanged and the "Merge branch 'main'" commit is still there. Missing: rebase onto main to drop the merge commit, so only the one coherent style commit remains.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign anyone yet. laurynmm gave the feedback and can re-check once the history is clean.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! The history still has a "Merge branch 'main'" commit, so please rebase onto main instead of merging and force-push so only the one style commit remains (see the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html)). Then ask for a review again.
```
